content:
I grew up in a time when we outfitted our Nokia phones with awesome faceplates. My local flea market was a great place to get them. MagSafe and iPhone cases are about as close as we will get to that today. ESR is launching its new summer series of iPhone 17 cases and MagSafe accessories.

MagSafe Monday: Every Monday, Bradley Chambers looks at the latest and greatest in the MagSafe and wireless charging industry to help you get the most out of your Apple devices that support wireless charging.

The Coastal Summer series

The Coastal Summer series aims to bring ocean colors and elements to your devices. It is a fun aesthetic for mixing up your devices this summer. This design is available across a few of ESR’s best MagSafe accessories.

For carrying your cards, they have the Aura Clutch Magnetic Wallet and the Classic Magnetic Wallet. The Aura Clutch holds your credit cards and doubles as a kickstand. The Classic Magnetic Wallet is a slimmer option that holds up to three cards and easily snaps on and off your iPhone as a traditional MagSafe wallet.

The Tropical Paradise series

If you prefer something a little more vibrant than the Coastal series, the Tropical Paradise series leans heavily into bold prints and jungle colors. Just like the Coastal series, you can get the Tropical Paradise designs on both the Clutch wallet and the Classic Magnetic Wallet.

Wrap up on the ESR summer collection

I really appreciate it when companies refresh their accessories for the season. You do not have to settle for a standard color case or wallet just to get a fun summer pattern. With the ESR Summer Collection, you get some of the best MagSafe accessories with a summer pattern.

You can find the new Coastal Summer and Tropical Paradise MagSafe gear on Amazon or directly from the ESR website.
